scripts.text:
[Angelo]
Pets went out the village~!!
Gosh... what can I do... ?
scripts.translation:
[安傑洛]
我的寵物跑到村子外面去了~！！
天哪...我該怎麼辦...？

scripts.text:
[Angelo]
The day is not finished yet.
You can only help once a day. Hehe.
scripts.translation:
[安傑洛]
今天還沒結束呢。
每天只能幫忙一次哦。呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Angelo]
My pets are in the field outside of the village.
Why did they leave? Please find them.
scripts.translation:
[安傑洛]
我的寵物在村子外面的田野裡。
它們為什麼跑掉了呢？請幫我找到它們。

scripts.text:
[Angelo]
Oh, thank you. You found all of 3 puppies.
Thanks a lot.
I hope this is useful to you. hoho.
scripts.translation:
[安傑洛]
哦，謝謝你！你把3只小狗都找回來了。
太感謝了。
希望這點心意能幫到你。呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Angelo]
Are you an adventurer? You came here right on time.
Puppies have been disappearing.
And someone said that they saw them out on the field just outside the village....
scripts.translation:
[安傑洛]
你是冒險者嗎？你來得正是時候。
小狗們一直在失蹤。有人說在村外的田野裡見過它們...

scripts.text:
[Angelo]
It's pretty difficult and dangerous to find 'em.
You have to find ^0000FF3 puppies^000000.
scripts.translation:
[安傑洛]
找到它們相當困難且危險。
你必須找到^0000FF3只小狗^000000。

scripts.text:
[Puppy]
bow! wow wow!
scripts.translation:
[小狗]
汪！汪汪！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah... who's a good puppy?
Ok, where are the others?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊...誰是好小狗？
好吧，其他的小狗在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Good. I found all 3 puppies.
Now I need to go tell Angelo.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很好。我找到了全部3只小狗。
現在我要去告訴安傑洛。

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
Hello.
I'm worried about ^FF0000Strange Hydra^000000's on
the south beach.
I hope some experienced adventurers
will come to help.
scripts.translation:
[露西亞]
你好。
我很擔心南邊海灘上的^FF0000變異海葵^000000。
希望有經驗的冒險者能來幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
Hello.
Have you come here to hunt ^FF0000Strange Hydra^000000s?
scripts.translation:
[露西亞]
你好。
你是來打^FF0000變異海葵^000000的嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: ^006400What is happening here?^000000

[Lucia]
Here, take this ^006400Hydra Ball^000000.
Use it to capture a ^FF0000Strange Hydra^8B4513.^000000
I hope you can do it~!
scripts.translation:
[露西亞]
拿著這個^006400海葵球^000000。
用它捕捉一隻^FF0000變異海葵^8B4513。^000000
希望你能成功~！

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
Ah, I misunderstood.
See you then.
scripts.translation:
[露西亞]
啊，我誤會了。
那再見了。

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
One day ^FF0000Strange Hydra^000000s
came here and surrounded the town.
We're not sure what attracted them but some say that it's because of you adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[露西亞]
有一天^FF0000變異海葵^000000來到這裡，包圍了城鎮。
我們不確定是什麼吸引了它們，但有人說這是因為你們冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
In any case, to contain the ^FF0000Strange Hydra^000000s,
you have to use this specially designed tool a.k.a. a ^8B4513Hydra Ball^000000
scripts.translation:
[露西亞]
總之，要制服^FF0000變異海葵^000000，就得用這種特別設計的工具，也就是^8B4513海葵球^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
If you still have the ^006400Hydra Ball^000000,
please use it on the ^FF0000Strange Hydra^000000s that
you can find at the beach.
If you are lucky, the tool will work perfectly.
scripts.translation:
[露西亞]
如果你還留著^006400海葵球^000000，就用它捕捉海灘上的^FF0000變異海葵^000000。
運氣好的話，這個工具就能順利發揮作用。

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
I hope many adventurers
volunteer for this job.
 
I really hate Hydra!
scripts.translation:
[露西亞]
我希望有很多冒險者自願承擔這項工作。
 
我真的很討厭海葵！

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
Hello, you really did it!
 
I'd like to reward you,
however your bags are full.
Please make room and come back!
scripts.translation:
[露西亞]
你好，你真的做到了！
 
我想獎勵你，但是你的背包滿了。
請騰出空間再回來！

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
Hello, you really did it!
I hope you will come
again to help me.
Have a nice day~!
scripts.translation:
[露西亞]
你好，你真的做到了！
希望你會再來幫我。
祝你有美好的一天~！

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
Any problems?
scripts.translation:
[露西亞]
有什麼問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
Did you need another ^006400Hydra Ball^000000?
I will give you one more.
scripts.translation:
[露西亞]
你還需要另一個^006400海葵球^000000嗎？
我再給你一個。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: ^006400Tell me again what happened^000000
scripts.translation: ^006400再告訴我一次發生了什麼^000000

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
Ok, please do me a favor.
scripts.translation:
[露西亞]
好的，請幫個忙。

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
Oh, ^0000FF{0}^000000 you're back.
Did you come here to hunt ^FF0000Strange Hydra^000000s?
scripts.translation:
[露西亞]
哦，^0000FF{0}^000000，你回來了。
你是來這裡打^FF0000變異海葵^000000的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
Oh, ^0000FF{0}^000000 you're back.
I'm so grateful for your help.
Each ^006400Hydra Ball^000000 is provided ^006400every 24 hours^000000
Please come at the appropriate time.
scripts.translation:
[露西亞]
哦，^0000FF{0}^000000，你回來了。
非常感謝你幫忙。
每^00640024小時^000000才能領取一次^006400海葵球^000000。
請在合適的時間再來。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: ^006400What is happening here?^000000

[Lucia]
Here, take this ^006400Hydra Ball^000000.
Use it to capture a ^FF0000Strange Hydra^8B4513.^000000
I hope you can do it~!
scripts.translation:
[露西亞]
拿著，這是^006400海葵球^000000。
用它來捕捉^FF0000變異海葵^8B4513。^000000
希望你能成功~！

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
Ah, I misunderstood.
See you then.
scripts.translation:
[露西亞]
啊，我誤會了。
那再見了。

scripts.text: - You can't start the quest. Please reduce the weight in your inventory. -
scripts.translation: - 無法開始任務。請減輕背包重量。 -

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Yo, do you know a berry called ^FF0000Guarana^000000?
scripts.translation:
[糖果師]
嘿，你知道一種叫^FF0000瓜拉那^000000的漿果嗎？

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Guarana is a really special berry raised in a specific area, it relieves physical fatigue, and gives power to the body. It even detoxes waste from the body.
scripts.translation:
[糖果師]
瓜拉那是一種在特定地區種植的特殊漿果，它能緩解身體疲勞，為身體提供能量，甚至能排出體內的毒素。

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
I used to sell the candy made of it back in the day.
I got a prize sometimes every year in the <annual best product contest>. Those were the good 'ol days.
scripts.translation:
[糖果師]
我以前賣用瓜拉那做的糖果。
幾乎每年都能在“年度最佳產品大賽”中獲獎。那真是段美好時光。

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Since then, the output of that fruit has reduced and the price has gone up so now candy ingredients were changed to coconuts or other tropical fruits instead. I miss the guarana candy.
scripts.translation:
[糖果師]
後來瓜拉那產量減少、價格上漲，如今糖果改用椰子或其他熱帶水果製作。我真懷念瓜拉那糖。

scripts.text: How can I taste this guarana candy?
scripts.translation: 我怎麼才能嚐到這種瓜拉那糖？

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Hmm? I already sold out of all my old supply.
scripts.translation:
[糖果師]
嗯？我以前的存貨已經賣光了。

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
But if you can find some guarana, I can make it for you.
scripts.translation:
[糖果師]
但如果你能找到一些瓜拉那，我可以為你製作。

scripts.text: How do I find guarana?
scripts.translation: 我怎麼找到瓜拉那？

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Will you find the guarana?? Hoooooh~
scripts.translation:
[糖果師]
你要去找瓜拉那嗎？哇哦~

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Can you find it?
It's probably very expensive.
Trading isn't my thing. Let me think.
scripts.translation:
[糖果師]
你能找到嗎？
那東西可能很貴。
我不擅長做生意。讓我想想辦法。

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Let me introduce you to someone with whom I used to do guarana business with.
He might still be dealing it.
scripts.translation:
[糖果師]
讓我介紹你認識一個人，我以前和他做過瓜拉那的生意。
他可能還在做這門生意。

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
His name is Cherto.
If you can't find him in the city, go to museum.
He's a vain person so he likes to act big.
He's probably wandering in the museum trying to show off to someone for sure.
scripts.translation:
[糖果師]
他叫切爾托。
如果在城裡找不到，就去博物館看看。
他很愛慕虛榮，喜歡擺架子，肯定在博物館裡四處向人炫耀。

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Don't you want to try the guarana candy?
scripts.translation:
[糖果師]
你不想嚐嚐瓜拉那糖嗎？

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Those were the good 'ole days...
scripts.translation:
[糖果師]
那是多麼美好的時光啊...

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
If you want to get the guarana, find Cherto.
Maybe he will be in the museum.
scripts.translation:
[糖果師]
如果你想要瓜拉那，去找切爾托。
他可能在博物館裡。

scripts.text: - The guarana that I had has disappeared. -
scripts.translation: - 我帶著的瓜拉那不見了。 -

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Did you get the guarana?
scripts.translation:
[糖果師]
你拿到瓜拉那了嗎？

scripts.text: - You give the guarana to him. -
scripts.translation: - 你把瓜拉那交給了他。 -

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Wow! You have special talent.
It's the best thing I have ever seen so far. Cool~!
scripts.translation:
[糖果師]
哇！你很有天賦。
這是我見過最棒的作品。太酷了~！

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Good, let's make the candy~!
Long time no see my wonderful guarana candy...
scripts.translation:
[糖果師]
好，咱們開始做糖果吧~！
好久沒做我最愛的瓜拉那糖了...

scripts.text:
- hash hash hash hash hash hash -
- hash hash hash hash hash hash -
scripts.translation:
- 沙沙沙沙沙沙 -
- 沙沙沙沙沙沙 -

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Look! It's the popular guarana candy.
Try to savor its amazing taste hey~ take it easy. hahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[糖果師]
看！這就是人氣瓜拉那糖。
好好嚐嚐它的美妙滋味...慢慢來。哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Guarana candy. That was the most unique masterpiece in my life for sure!
scripts.translation:
[糖果師]
瓜拉那糖。這絕對是我一生中獨一無二的傑作！

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Since you helped me, guarana supply has been steadily rising.
So, naturally I'm back to making guarana candy.
scripts.translation:
[糖果師]
多虧了你幫忙，瓜拉那的供應一直穩步增加。
所以，我自然而然地重新開始製作瓜拉那糖了。

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
What about it? Wanna buy some?
It's 4000 zeny each.
scripts.translation:
[糖果師]
怎麼樣？想買一些嗎？
每個4000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Buy a Guarana Candy.
scripts.translation: 購買瓜拉那糖

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Here is a delicious guarana candy.
scripts.translation:
[糖果師]
這是一塊美味的瓜拉那糖。

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
What? You should say before if you don't have money!
Even if you are poor, I can't give this away for free.
scripts.translation:
[糖果師]
什麼？沒錢你應該早點說啊！
就算你窮，我也不能免費送你。

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Sometimes some people don't like it due to it's arousal effect.
scripts.translation:
[糖果師]
有些人不喜歡它，因為吃了會興奮。

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Guarana candy. That was the most unique masterpiece in my life for sure!
scripts.translation:
[糖果師]
瓜拉那糖。這絕對是我一生中獨一無二的傑作！

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Hmm... hey man, you are from outside, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
嗯...嘿，夥計，你是外地人吧？

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Cherto can figure it out even if it's the first time. You can't trick Cherto.
Cherto has sharp eyes like an eagle! Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
切爾托一眼就能看出來！你騙不了切爾托。
切爾托有一雙鷹眼！哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Ok, ok. Yes, yes. I see!
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
好的，好的。是的，是的。我明白了！

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Anyway, you arrived in Brasilis but don't know what to do?
Am I right?
You don't know how fortunate you are to have found a really proper helper as myself.
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
總之，你來到巴西，卻不知道該做什麼？
我說得沒錯吧？
你真幸運，遇到了我這樣可靠的幫手。

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Cherto takes it by your expression that you want to say, ''You are a master!'' Right?
Cherto, I can read and figure out all at once! That is written in your face!
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
切爾托從你的表情看出，你想說：“你真是大師！”對吧？
切爾托一眼就能看穿一切，你的心思全寫在臉上了！

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Cherto would love to stay here and explain everything to you but he is a busy man.
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
切爾托本想留在這裡給你解釋一切，但切爾托是個大忙人。

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
If you have a curious thing to ask to Cherto. Cherto will be kind enough to answer.
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
如果你有什麼問題想問切爾托，切爾托會很樂意回答。

scripts.text: Guarana?
scripts.translation: 瓜拉那？

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
What? Do you want to find a guarana?
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
什麼？你想找瓜拉那？

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Guarana is only raised in this area, it has a soft inside and is coverd with a light fur.
It seems a little bit weird but the flower is really big and smells beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
瓜拉那隻生長在這一帶，果肉柔軟，外面覆著淺色絨毛。
看起來有點奇特，但它的花很大，香氣也很迷人。

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
A long time ago, guarana was used to relieve desease and thirst. But recently it's getting popular to revitalize body power and increase blood circulation.
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
以前，瓜拉那用來治病解渴。最近則因為能恢復體力、促進血液迴圈而大受歡迎。

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Although it has such great effects, Cherto is sorry to inform you that we can't get it anymore.
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
雖然它有這麼好的功效，但很遺憾地通知你，我們現在已經買不到了。

scripts.text: Whaaaat??
scripts.translation: 什...什麼？

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
For a while now, guarana berries haven't been growing here.
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
這段時間以來，這裡都沒再長出瓜拉那。

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Even if Cherto managed to find one, it will rot quickly.
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
就算切爾托找到一顆，它也會很快腐爛。

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
If only it didn't happen!
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
要是沒發生這種事就好了！

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Quiet!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
This story has been forbidden! Someone might be listening to our conversation...
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
安靜！！！！
這個故事是禁忌！說不定有人正在偷聽...

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
If Cherto tells you, you might get us into trouble. But you look like you really wanna know so let me give you a tip.
Come closer. Cherto will whisper so nobody can listen in.
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
切爾托要是告訴你，可能會惹上麻煩。不過看你真的很想知道，我就給你一點提示。
靠近些，我小聲告訴你，免得被別人聽見。

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
A Guarana boy was born.
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
一個瓜拉那男孩出生了。

scripts.text: Guarana kid?
scripts.translation: 瓜拉那小孩？

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
There was woman who was an expert botanist.
The woman was really popular to all living creatures.
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
有一位精通植物學的女子。
她深受所有生靈的喜愛。

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
At around the time her baby was born, she started a guarana farm. For some reason, her brothers were jealous so they destroyed the farm and disappeared.
That kind of story...
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
她生下孩子前後，開始種植瓜拉那。不知為何，她的兄弟們嫉妒她，毀掉了農場後便消失了。
故事大概就是這樣...

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
We can't be sure that baby was born in the world but since that time, all guarana in Brasilis disappeared.
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
我們無法確定那個孩子是否真的出生了，但從那時起，巴西的瓜拉那就全都消失了。

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Who is the guarana kid?
Pedro who is famous as a greedy man?
Meto who can't endure about all the fruits?
Hovenue who is gloomy?
They might know~!
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
那個瓜拉那小孩究竟是誰？
是貪婪出名的佩德羅？
是忍不住要吃水果的梅托？
還是總是悶悶不樂的霍維紐？
他們說不定知道~！

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
What about you?
Who is the guarana kid?
Will you figure out it? hohohhhhh~
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
那麼，你覺得呢？
瓜拉那小孩到底是誰？
你能查出來嗎？呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Can you find the guarana kid?
Maybe yes? Maybe no?
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
你能找到瓜拉那小孩嗎？
也許能？也許不能？

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Did you find guarana kid?
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
你找到瓜拉那小孩了嗎？

scripts.text: - I tell Cherto about the kid making animal-like sounds. -
scripts.translation: - 告訴切爾托那個發出像動物叫聲的小孩。 -

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Hoooh. That's unbelievable.
That kid might be a guarana kid. Sure...
According to the story the kid can have conversations with animals.
scripts.translation:
[切爾托]
哇，這真令人難以置信。

這裡的植物枝幹粗壯，色彩鮮明豔麗。
它們長得十分高大，存在感十足。

scripts.text:
[Karmen]
It's a botanist's dream.
scripts.translation:
[卡門]
這是植物學家的夢想。

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Boy]
Grandma! That person has a weird smell.
scripts.translation:
[巴西男孩]
奶奶！那個人身上有股怪味。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
This person isn't from here.
Say hello to our guest.
scripts.translation:
[瑪爾塔]
這個人不是本地人。
跟我們的客人打個招呼吧。

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Boy]
heee~ hi!!
I am Kaka!!
Whats your name?
scripts.translation:
[巴西男孩]
嘿嘿~你好！！
我叫卡卡！！
你叫什麼名字？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Boy]
The outsider has a weird name!
Thas ok! If we keep talking we'll be friends! Cheer up!
scripts.translation:
[巴西男孩]
外地人的名字真奇怪！
不過沒關係！多聊幾句就能成為朋友！打起精神來！

scripts.text:
[Marta]
Hehe...
So, why have you come here stranger~?
scripts.translation:
[瑪爾塔]
呵呵...
那麼，陌生人，你為什麼來這裡呢~？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I heard you knows lots of stories, is that true?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我聽說你知道很多故事，是真的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kaka]
Wooo! how you know my grandma knows lots of stories, amazing~?
Grandma is really wise and kind so, I heard lotsa things.
scripts.translation:
[卡卡]
哇！你怎麼知道我奶奶很會講故事？好厲害~
奶奶聰明又善良，所以我聽她講了好多故事。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
Hehe. Kaka always listens to many stories every night, he really likes my stories.
Kaka always makes me happy because he asks so many curious things. That is pure happiness.
scripts.translation:
[瑪爾塔]
呵呵，卡卡每晚都聽我講故事，他最喜歡這些故事了。
他總是問我各種有趣的問題，讓我很開心。這就是最簡單的幸福。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
Ok, Kaka why don't you invite our guest today to our small meeting?
scripts.translation:
[瑪爾塔]
卡卡，今天也邀請這位客人來參加我們的小聚會吧？

scripts.text:
[Kaka]
Ok grandma~!!
scripts.translation:
[卡卡]
好的奶奶~！！

scripts.text:
[Marta]
Hey~ do you have special story that you want to listen to?
scripts.translation:
[瑪爾塔]
嘿~你想聽什麼特別的故事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
About the mysterious water lily?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
關於神秘蓮花的故事？

scripts.text:
[Marta]
Water lily....
It's from a long long time ago.
scripts.translation:
[瑪爾塔]
蓮花...
那是很久很久以前的事了。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
Before Brasilis was established.
A tribe that lived with the giant waterfall and jungle as friends spent their whole time with nature.
scripts.translation:
[瑪爾塔]
在巴西建立之前，有個部落與巨大的瀑布和叢林為伴，世世代代親近自然。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
One of tribe chiefs had a pretty daughter called 'Naia'.
scripts.translation:
[瑪爾塔]
部落首領有一個美麗的女兒，名叫“奈亞”。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
Naia liked listening to stories like Kaka so, her mom told her stories every night about nature and gods.
scripts.translation:
[瑪爾塔]
奈亞和卡卡一樣喜歡聽故事，所以她的母親每晚都會給她講自然與神靈的故事。

scripts.text:
[Kaka]
Woooa, she's just like me!
Maybe she would be pretty... hehe.
scripts.translation:
[卡卡]
哇哦，她跟我一樣！
也許她也很漂亮...嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
According to her mother...
If the moon in the sky loves some woman in the earth, he turns her into a star so that they can stay together forever.
scripts.translation:
[瑪爾塔]
據她母親說...
如果天上的月亮愛上地上的女子，就會把她變成星星，讓兩人永遠相伴。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
After Naia heard this story, she went to her dad to ask if it was true or not.
scripts.translation:
[瑪爾塔]
奈亞聽完這個故事後，去找爸爸問這是不是真的。

scripts.text:
[Kaka]
So, what did he say?
scripts.translation:
[卡卡]
那他怎麼說？

scripts.text:
[Marta]
^3131FF'My dear, Naia the moon is one of the bravest men. But he can no longer have a bride. So you can't become a star... Sorry~.^000000
scripts.translation:
[瑪爾塔]
^3131FF“親愛的奈亞，月亮是最勇敢的男人之一，但他已經不能再娶新娘了。所以你無法成為星星...對不起~。”^000000

scripts.text:
[Kaka]
Did Naia wants to be the bride of the man?
scripts.translation:
[卡卡]
奈亞想嫁給那個男人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marta]
Yes Kaka, imagine the moon how beautiful and mysterious, that's just ideal for girls.
scripts.translation:
[瑪爾塔]
是啊，卡卡。想想看，月亮多麼美麗又神秘，對女孩來說簡直是理想物件。

scripts.text:
[Kaka]
But the moon doesn't meet a human as his wife anymore? What was going on with Naia?
scripts.translation:
[卡卡]
可是月亮不再娶人類做妻子了嗎？奈亞後來怎麼樣了？

scripts.text:
[Marta]
Naia was really a nice girl.
scripts.translation:
[瑪爾塔]
奈亞真的是個很好的女孩。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
Although her parents tried to prevent her, she still went to the forest to meet the moon every night.
Sadly, even with all of her effort, the moon didn't show any reaction to her.
scripts.translation:
[瑪爾塔]
儘管父母試圖阻止她，她還是每晚都去森林裡見月亮。
可惜無論她多努力，月亮都沒有回應她。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
One day she also went to the top of the mountain to be closer to him. She decided to take a rest for a while around the lake.
scripts.translation:
[瑪爾塔]
有一天，她也爬到了山頂，為了離他更近一些。她決定在湖邊休息一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
That's when.. Naia saw it.
It was the moon he was shining beautifully over the waving lake lightly.
scripts.translation:
[瑪爾塔]
就在那時...奈亞看見了。
月亮的光芒映在微微盪漾的湖面上，顯得格外美麗。

scripts.text:
[Kaka]
I know, it's just the moon reflecting on the water. Right?!
scripts.translation:
[卡卡]
我知道，那只是月亮在水中的倒影。對吧？！

scripts.text:
[Marta]
Yes, but to her, the image made her fall into the lake without hesitating and drowned.
scripts.translation:
[瑪爾塔]
沒錯。但她看著那倒影，毫不猶豫地跳進湖裡，結果溺水身亡。

scripts.text:
[Kaka]
Oh no.
scripts.translation:
[卡卡]
糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
The moon was also watching her from the sky.
He felt sad and pitied her. So he decided to turn her into a beautiful flower to thank her for her love.
scripts.translation:
[瑪爾塔]
月亮也在天空中注視著她。
他感到悲傷，也憐憫她。為了回應她的愛，他決定把她變成一朵美麗的花。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
That is the story of the mysterious flower people called the Brasilis Water Flower.
This Naia flower appears as light white during daytime but in the night turns into red due to it's love connection to the moon.
scripts.translation:
[瑪爾塔]
這就是巴西水花的傳說。
這種奈亞花白天呈淡白色，到了夜晚，因為與月亮相連的愛意而變成紅色。

scripts.text:
[Kaka]
How sad but beautiful!
scripts.translation:
[卡卡]
真悲傷，但也很美！

scripts.text:
[Marta]
How about you stranger?
Did you enjoy this story?
If you want to listen to another story, just come to me.
If you don't mind playing with my grandson a ~ little. hoohoo.
scripts.translation:
[瑪爾塔]
陌生人，你覺得這個故事怎麼樣？喜歡嗎？
還想聽故事的話，隨時來找我。
也可以陪我孫子玩一會兒。呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Kaka]
My grandma is really a bit tired doing some tribe stuff!
Could you come another day?
scripts.translation:
[卡卡]
奶奶忙部落裡的事，累壞了！
你改天再來好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marta]
You are not from around here.
I can sense a strange earth smell.
scripts.translation:
[瑪爾塔]
你不是本地人。
我能聞到你身上陌生的氣息。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
But your eyes shine with strength.
Indeed you are spreading out spirit and will from your whole body.
scripts.translation:
[瑪爾塔]
不過，你眼中閃爍著力量。
你的全身都散發著精神與意志。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
If you work at it you will be a great person someday.
scripts.translation:
[瑪爾塔]
如果你努力的話，總有一天你會成為一個偉大的人。

scripts.text:
[Distant Sound]
Jasira!!!
Where are you going again?!!
come back~, please!!
scripts.translation:
[遠處的聲音]
雅西拉！！！
你又要去哪裡？！！
回來吧~，求你了！！

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Girl]
Mom, I have to go out!!
scripts.translation:
[巴西女孩]
媽媽，我必須出去！！

scripts.text:
[Distant Sound]
No way~!! You shouldn't!!
scripts.translation:
[遠處的聲音]
不行~！！你不應該去！！

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Girl]
Gosh.. today also failed.
scripts.translation:
[巴西女孩]
天哪...今天又失敗了。

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Girl]
......
What's up? Why are you looking at me?
I don't want to be a showgirl!! Get out!!
scripts.translation:
[巴西女孩]
......
怎麼了？為什麼盯著我看？
我才不想當舞女！！快走開！！

scripts.text: Nothing, sorry.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼，抱歉

scripts.text: What's wrong?
scripts.translation: 怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Girl]
I am so sad!!!
scripts.translation:
[巴西女孩]
我好難過！！！

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Girl]
It's not your business.
You are just an outsider!
scripts.translation:
[巴西女孩]
這不關你的事。
你只是個外人！

scripts.text: How rude!
scripts.translation: 真沒禮貌！

scripts.text: Just trying to help.
scripts.translation: 只是想幫幫你

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Girl]
What's it matter to you that I'm rude??!!
scripts.translation:
[巴西女孩]
我粗魯又怎樣？！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I know that I'm just passing by but I might be able to help you. What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我知道自己只是路過，但也許能幫到你。你覺得呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This kind of meeting could be more than just a coincidence.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這次相遇或許並非巧合。

[巴西女孩]
...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm can you tell me your name?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，能告訴我你的名字嗎？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Girl]
ja...
Jasira.
My name is Jasira.
scripts.translation:
[巴西女孩]
雅...
雅西拉。
我叫雅西拉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Nice name~.
Jasira what's going on?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
名字真好聽~
雅西拉，到底怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
I have to meet 'Jasi' but I can't go out....
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
我要去見“雅西”，但我不能出門...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
who is Jasi?
Your.... lover?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
雅西是誰？
是你的...戀人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
l...o...v...e...lover??!!
No way~
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
戀...人...？！！
才不是呢~

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
If he is my lover, it would be great... but...
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
如果他是我的戀人就好了...但是...

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Jasi is......
the great moon.
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
雅西是...
偉大的月亮。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The moon?
Maybe... are you talking about the moon from the story?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
月亮？
難道...你說的是故事裡的月亮？

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Yeah!
Dear Jasi is from the moon from the sky!
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
是的！
親愛的雅西來自天空中的月亮！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why are you thinking like that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你為什麼這麼想？

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Cuz' Jasi is really gorgeous and the most important thing is he is taking care of the water lily in Brasilis.
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
因為雅西真的很英俊，更重要的是，他照料著巴西的睡蓮。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Brasilis water lily??!!
Isn't it the uniqe flower?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
巴西睡蓮？！
那不是一種獨特的花嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Right. It's a really mysterious flower and difficult to find.
But around Jasi there are lots of water lilies.
That's why I believe Jasi is the moon.
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
沒錯。那是一種很神奇的花，很難找到。
但在雅西身邊有很多蓮花。
所以我相信雅西就是月亮。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where is Jasi?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
雅西在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
He is deep inside the Jungle.
As you can see I am so weak so, I've been staying home. But once, I was strong enough to leave this village.
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
他在叢林深處。
你看，我現在很虛弱，只能待在家裡。不過以前我身體好時，也能離開村子。

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
I just wandered the jungle and fell down somewhere and that's where I saw him.
He was so nice. He helped heal me and guided me back home.
That was really really great time.
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
我曾在叢林裡閒逛，不知怎麼摔倒了，就在那裡遇見他。
他人很好，幫我療傷，還送我回家。那真是一段美好的時光。

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Since I came back home, my parents punished me.
I can understand why they are worrying but i missed Jasi a lot!
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
回家後，父母懲罰了我。
我明白他們為何擔心，可我太想念雅西了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why don't you meet him after recovering your strength?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等你恢復體力後再去見他，怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
.................
I wanna see him right now...
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
...
我現在就想見他...

scripts.text: Help Jasira.
scripts.translation: 幫助雅西拉

scripts.text: Ignore her.
scripts.translation: 無視她

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sorry I can't help you. Cheer up!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，我幫不了你。振作點！

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Crying........
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
哭泣...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Jasira I came here to find the Brasilis water lily.
Don't you think fate has brought us together?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
雅西拉，我來這裡是為了尋找巴西睡蓮。
你不覺得我們相遇是命運的安排嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you tell me how to find Jasi, I can help you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你告訴我怎麼找到雅西，我就可以幫你。

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Really? But I don't know exactly how to get there. I was just wandering around when I met him.
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
真的嗎？但我不知道確切的路怎麼走。我只是在閒逛時遇見他的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Can't you remember anything?
If you know something you've gotta tell me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你一點印象都沒有嗎？
如果你知道什麼，一定要告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Let's see... I was wandering around a waterfall then fell down into the water then I was sucked into somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
讓我想想...我當時在瀑布附近閒逛，後來掉進水裡，被水流捲到了某個地方。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Good, that's better than nothing! I will look for a similar place.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很好，總比沒有線索強！我會去找找類似的地方。

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
I gave you your information, so can you do me a favor?
It's really simple...
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
我把情報都告訴你了，你能幫我個忙嗎？
其實很簡單...

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
I'd like to give a delicious fruit.
The place where Jas seemed cozy but I didn't see any food around... So if he sees a yummy fruit he will be happy!
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
我想送他一些好吃的水果。
雅西住的地方很舒適，可附近似乎沒有食物...要是他看到美味的水果，一定會很開心！

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Give him 10 Banana and tell him that I really miss him.
Sorry for ignoring you before. Please, only you can help me!
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
給他10個香蕉，並告訴他我很想念他。
抱歉之前忽略了你。拜託了，只有你能幫到我！

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
If you meet Jasi, give him 10 Bananas.
Let's see... I was wandering around a waterfall then fell down into the water then I was sucked into somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
見到雅西的話，給他10個香蕉。
讓我想想...我當時在瀑布附近閒逛，後來掉進水裡，被水流捲到了某個地方。

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
If you can't find the way, go up to the waterfall and ask the kids in Brasilis village.
I heard one of the children went to a strange place before. He might've gone to the same place as me!
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
如果你找不到路，就去瀑布那裡問問巴西村莊的小孩。
我聽說有個孩子之前去過一個奇怪的地方。他可能和我去了同一個地方！

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Did you meet Jasi?
Did you talk about me?
You didn't? Uh? Stupid! Gosh~!
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
你見到雅西了嗎？
有跟我提起我嗎？
沒有嗎？啊？笨蛋！真是的~！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey girl~ you've got a short temper.
I did see him and I talked about you!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，姑娘~你也太心急了。
我見到他了，也告訴他你的事了！

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Did you?
What did he say?
Does he remember me?
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
真的嗎？
他說了什麼？
他記得我嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That you have a really good heart~
I told him that you will try to meet him when your condition gets better.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他說你心地很好~
我告訴他，等你身體好轉，就會去見他。

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Yeahhhhh!!
Thank you! You are more reliable than I thought you would be.
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
耶~~~~！！
謝謝你！你比我想像的更可靠呢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyway, I'm looking for a fruit that's brown and has a hard shell.
It has juice inside and can be used as a cup to drink out of.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
對了，我在找一種棕色、外殼很硬的水果。
裡面有很多汁水，可以當杯子用來喝水。

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Duh! You mean a coconut right?!
They're everywhere here in Brasilis.
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
哈！你是說椰子吧？！
在巴西這裡到處都是。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thanks Jasira!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝雅西拉！

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
I should take care of my strength by myself!
I can't just lie in my bed forever. Don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
我應該自己努力恢復體力！
不能一直躺在床上。你覺得呢？

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Uh? Why have you come back?
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
啊？你怎麼又回來了？

scripts.text: - You tell her what Jasi told you to tell her -
scripts.translation: - 告訴她雅西讓你轉達的話 -

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Oh... really?
Did he say that?
Gosh! Gosh!!!
Kkkkkaaaaa - !!
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
哦...真的嗎？
他這麼說的嗎？
天哪！天哪！！！
卡...卡...卡...！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thanks to you, I was able to get a flower.
Thanks a lot!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
多虧了你，我拿到了一朵花。
非常感謝！！

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Wooow. It's so beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
哇哦。真漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Ah... can I see it for a second?
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
啊...能讓我看一眼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Surprise~!!
I've been working on this hat while you were gone and now it's complete with the water lily flower!
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
驚喜~！！
趁你不在的時候，我一直在做這頂帽子，現在配上蓮花就完工了！

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
I know, I know! I'm the best...
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
我知道，我知道！我是最棒的...

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
I just need to get a little bit stronger!
I can't just lie in bed forever. My Jasi is waiting for me~
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
我只需要再強壯一點！
不能一直躺在床上。我的雅西在等著我呢~

scripts.text:
[Distant Sound]
Jasira!!!
Where are you going again?!!
Come back~, please!!
scripts.translation:
[遠處的聲音]
雅西拉！！！
你又要去哪裡？！！
回來吧~，求你了！！

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Girl]
Please mom~!
Please let me go!
scripts.translation:
[巴西女孩]
拜託了，媽媽~！
請讓我去吧！

scripts.text:
[Recluse]
Oh, I haven't seen another person in such a long time.
scripts.translation:
[隱居者]
好久沒有見到其他人了。

scripts.text: Keep going.
scripts.translation: 繼續前進

scripts.text: Are you the moon?
scripts.translation: 你是月亮嗎？

scripts.text:
[Recluse]
You don't have specific business with me.
scripts.translation:
[隱居者]
你並沒有特別的事情要找我。

scripts.text:
[Recluse]
Moon?
My name is Jasi.
My family has worked to take care of the water lily from generation to generation.
scripts.translation:
[隱居者]
月亮？
我叫雅西。
我家世世代代都在照料蓮花。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Basically the Brasilis water lily is too shy to appear in front of people so, they only bloom in rare places. I guess they like it here, though, that's why I've been staying here for such a long time.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
巴西蓮花十分害羞，很少在人前出現，只有在少數地方才會開花。我想它們很喜歡這裡，所以我在這裡待了這麼久。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
My family has taken care of the water lily calmly to prevent harm from people's hand or monsters.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
我家世世代代都在照料蓮花，保護它們免受人類和魔物的傷害。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you remember a girl named Jasi.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你還記得一個叫雅西的女孩嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Ja...si..........
Ah!! a hurry scurry girl. 
Gosh.. I was in trouble due to that girl.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
雅...西...
啊！！那個急躁的女孩。
天哪...因為那個女孩，我差點陷入麻煩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Trouble?

[Jasi]
One day a young lady appeared with lots of scars so I helped her. Then suddenly she tried to pick up the water lily and asked me to accept her as my wife or make her into a water lily what a nutcase!
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
有一天，一位滿身傷痕的年輕女士出現了，我幫助了她。然後她突然想摘走蓮花，並要求我娶她為妻，或者把她變成一朵蓮花，真是個瘋子！

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
I was barely able to calm down and send her to the village.
My life is that water lily so I didn't want anything embarrassing to happen.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
我好不容易才讓她冷靜下來，把她送回了村莊。
我的生命就是這朵蓮花，我不想發生任何尷尬的事情。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is a gift from Jasira to say sorry for that time.
She is really sad that can't come here by herself due to private difficulties.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是雅西拉寄來的禮物，為了那件事道歉。
她因為私事無法親自前來，感到非常難過。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
What are you saying?
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
你在說什麼？

scripts.text: - Oh yeah, I forgot to bring 10 Bananas -
scripts.translation: - 哦對了，我忘了帶10根香蕉 -

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Ah! Bananas! Wow it's been a long time. She's pretty considerate isn't she?
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
啊！香蕉！哇，已經很久沒吃了。她真貼心，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Anyway is that all the business you have with me?
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
總之，這就是你要找我的所有事情嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Umm honestly I was wondering to find water lily and met you by coincidence. Jasira told me her sad story so that's what led me here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，說實話，我是想尋找蓮花，偶然遇到了你。雅西拉告訴了我她的悲傷故事，所以我才來到這裡。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
I got it.
As you can see, there are lots of Brasilis water lily around here.
If you make sure that you won't destroy them you can appreciate them as you wish.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
我明白了。
如你所見，這裡有很多巴西的蓮花。
只要你保證不會破壞它們，你可以盡情欣賞。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Did you enjoy the water lily?
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
你欣賞蓮花盡興了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
I forgot what the name of that fruit was...
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
我忘了那種水果叫什麼名字了...

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
I forgot what the name of that fruit was...
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
我忘了那種水果叫什麼名字了...

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Did you find the fruit?
Oh right this is....?
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
你找到那種水果了嗎？
對了，這個叫...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's called a 'coconut'.

[Jasi]
Ahah! COCONUT!!
Now I remember thank you very much. I can't remember the last time I had this fruit.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
啊哈！椰子！！
我想起來了，非常感謝。我已經很久沒吃過這種水果了。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
I guess I should keep my promise.
You can take one Water lily.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
我想我應該信守承諾。
你可以摘一朵蓮花。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
I hope the Brasilis water lily will understand me.
You better grab the flower while you have a chance~
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
希望巴西的蓮花能理解我的心意。
趁現在還有機會，趕緊把花摘走吧~

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Oh, can you tell that girl Jasira something for me?
Tell her that I am not the moon from the story, but I want to become the moon to shine only for her.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
哦，你能幫我告訴那個女孩雅西拉幾句話嗎？
告訴她，我不是故事裡的月亮，但我想成為月亮，只為她一人閃耀。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
The flowers blooming from the Water lily today is wonderful.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
今天從蓮花上綻放的花朵真美。

scripts.text: An unusual Water lily is blooming here. You can't stop staring at it, knowing that few people have seen this flower bloom.
scripts.translation: 這裡有一株罕見的蓮花正在綻放。你知道很少有人見過它開花，所以忍不住一直盯著看。

scripts.text: Pick up the flower.
scripts.translation: 摘取花朵

scripts.text: Keep gazing.
scripts.translation: 繼續凝視

scripts.text: - You can't avoid staring at it's beauty. -
scripts.translation: - 你無法移開視線，被它的美麗深深吸引。 -

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Uh! What are you doing??!!
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
喂！你在幹什麼？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There is a person who really needs this flower, can I just take one of 'em?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有個人非常需要這朵花，我可以摘一朵嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
As I said earlier, I am the guardian of this water lily.
I can't just stand by here and watch you pluck even a single flower from it.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
正如我之前所說，我是這株蓮花的守護者。
我不能站在這裡看著你從上面摘哪怕一朵花。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey man~ I brought these delicious fruits for you... try it! They are really well matured and fresh bananas.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，夥計~ 我給你帶了這些美味的水果...嚐嚐看！它們非常成熟，是新鮮的香蕉。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
What are you saying?
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
你在說什麼？

scripts.text: - Oh yeah, I forgot to bring 10 Bananas -
scripts.translation: - 哦對了，我忘了帶10根香蕉 -

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Hmm... It's been so long since I've had this fruit.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
嗯...我已經很久沒吃過這種水果了。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
I will just try one. That's all.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
我就嘗一個。僅此而已。

scripts.text:
- munch -
- mumble mumble mumble -
scripts.translation:
- 嚼聲 -
- 含糊不清的聲音 -

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Uh, this taste... is!
I remember my mom baking these into a tasty bread!
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
嗯，這個味道...是！
我想起來了，媽媽曾把這些烤成美味的麵包！

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
It makes me miss my childhood.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
這讓我想起了我的童年。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Hoho!!!!
I've been here for as long as I can remember...
I don't have enough time to even do simple things like eat delicious fruit.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
Hoho!!!!！！
從我記事起就一直待在這裡...
我甚至連吃點美味水果這種小事都沒時間做。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
It was a really delicious banana.
But rules are rules!
I must do my duty.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
那根香蕉真的很美味。
但規矩就是規矩！
我必須履行我的職責。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please! I just need one flower~ What can I do to convince you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
拜託了！我只想要一朵花~ 我該怎麼做才能說服你呢？

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Rules are rules, what do you want from me?
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
規矩就是規矩，你還想讓我怎樣？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Didn't that banana remind you of your childhood? What can I get for you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
剛才那根香蕉不是讓你想起了童年嗎？我給你弄點別的？

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Now that you mention it, there is one fruit that I really miss.
It was my favorite when I was young but I don't remember what it was called.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
你這麼一說，確實有一種水果讓我很懷念。
小時候我最喜歡它了，但我記不清它叫什麼名字了。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
It's brown and has a hard shell around it. It has juice inside and you can use it as a cup when you're done eating the fruit.
Do you know what it is?
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
它是棕色的，外面有一層硬殼。裡面有很多汁水，吃完果肉後還可以把殼當杯子用。
你知道那是什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
If you bring 5 of those things, I will reconsider your suggestion.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
如果你能給我帶來5個那樣的東西，我會重新考慮你的提議。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok so I have to bring 5 fruits with hard shells.
Hmm what is it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，所以我得帶5個有硬殼的水果。
嗯，那是什麼來著？

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
It was my favorite when I was young but I don't remember what it was called.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
小時候我最喜歡它了，但我記不清它叫什麼名字了。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
It's brown and has a hard shell around it. It has juice inside and you can use it as a cup when you're done eating the fruit.
Do you know what it is?
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
它是棕色的，外面有一層硬殼。裡面有很多汁水，吃完果肉後還可以把殼當杯子用。
你知道那是什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
- wait a second!! -
- you have too many items -
- so you can't get any more items. -
- make your body lighter -
- then try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！！ -
- 你的背包裡東西太多 -
- 無法再拿取物品。 -
- 請減輕負重 -
- 然後重試。 -

scripts.text: - You take a beautiful water lily carefully in your hands. -
scripts.translation: - 你小心翼翼地接過一朵美麗的蓮花。 -

scripts.text:
[Pedro]
Wow it's really a great statue!
scripts.translation:
[佩德羅]
哇，這雕像真的很棒！

scripts.text:
[Mariana]
It is, isn't it?
This statue is called Verass Monument.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安娜]
是吧？
這座雕像叫做維拉斯紀念碑。

scripts.text:
[Mariana]
A long time ago there was a really brave adventurer named Verass, thanks to his dedicated exploration, Brasilis was able to develop into this great city.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安娜]
很久以前，有一位非常勇敢的冒險者名叫維拉斯。多虧了他不懈的探索，巴西才能發展成這樣的大城市。

scripts.text:
[Pedro]
Awesome!!
i wanna become a real man like Verass.
scripts.translation:
[佩德羅]
太帥了！！
我想成為像維拉斯那樣的真正的男子漢。

scripts.text:
[Mariana]
Pedro, you can become whatever you want.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安娜]
佩德羅，你想成為什麼樣子都可以。

scripts.text:
[Pedro]
Mariana is so smart, isn't she? hehe.
scripts.translation:
[佩德羅]
瑪麗安娜真聰明，對吧？嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
Ooooh! You love her don't you!
scripts.translation:
[法比奧]
噢噢噢！你喜歡她，對不對！

scripts.text:
[Daniel]
Wooooaaaa Pedro and Mari sitting in a tree!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼爾]
哇哦，佩德羅和瑪麗坐在一棵樹上！

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
Woooo k-i-s-s-i-n-g~!!!
scripts.translation:
[法比奧]
哇哦哦哦 親~親~親~！！！

scripts.text:
[Daniel]
Nya nya nya!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼爾]
喵~喵~喵~！

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
Hahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[法比奧]
哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Pedro]
Stop acting like babies!
scripts.translation:
[佩德羅]
別像小孩子一樣鬧了！

scripts.text:
[Mariana]
Boys~!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安娜]
男孩們~！

scripts.text:
[Daniel]
Yah yah...
Hey guys, did you hear that something happened a few days ago?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼爾]
是是是...
嘿，大家，你們聽說前幾天發生的事了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mariana]
Oh yeah~ I heard that something really scary happened.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安娜]
哦，是嘛~ 我聽說發生了很可怕的事情。

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
Uh, yeah that's why Mariana got scared of going ot the bathroom for 3 days and everything was stinky. Ewwww~
scripts.translation:
[法比奧]
嗯，對啊，所以瑪麗安娜嚇得三天不敢去廁所，結果到處臭烘烘的。嘔~

scripts.text:
[Daniel]
Ha ha ha! Smelly Mari!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼爾]
哈哈哈！臭烘烘的瑪麗！

scripts.text:
[Mariana]
I hate you~!
Stop spreading rumors about me. I'm not scared of the bathroom.
Pedro, do you think that I stink?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安娜]
討厭你們~！
別再傳我的謠言了。我才不怕廁所呢。
佩德羅，你覺得我臭嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pedro]
Uh? Uh?
N......no... no way.
Hey guys~ be nice to her~
scripts.translation:
[佩德羅]
呃？呃？
不...不...不會吧。
大家~ 對她好一點~

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
kkkickkkkkkkkick
scripts.translation:
[法比奧]
踢踢踢踢踢踢

scripts.text:
[Daniel]
kkkickkkkkkkk
scripts.translation:
[丹尼爾]
踢踢踢踢踢踢

scripts.text: Walk by.
scripts.translation: 路過

scripts.text: Ask about the gossip.
scripts.translation: 打聽八卦

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
Mariana~ smells~ Nya nya~
scripts.translation:
[法比奧]
瑪麗安娜~ 好臭~ 喵~喵~

scripts.text:
[Daniel]
Oh man you stink too~! Nya nya~
scripts.translation:
[丹尼爾]
天哪，你也很臭~！喵~喵~

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
Haven't you heard?
The ghost story in the art museum.
scripts.translation:
[法比奧]
你沒聽說嗎？
美術館裡的幽靈故事。

scripts.text:
[Daniel]
Ooohhhh! Scary~~~!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼爾]
噢噢噢！好可怕~~~！

scripts.text: Can you tell me more?
scripts.translation: 能多告訴我一些嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
A coupla days ago we went to the art museum for a picnic at school.
You know nothing special, just a ordinary field trip.
scripts.translation:
[法比奧]
前幾天學校組織去美術館野餐。
沒什麼特別的，就是普通的校外教學。

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
Museums are boring so me and some friends snuck away from the group~!
scripts.translation:
[法比奧]
博物館太無聊了，所以我和幾個朋友偷偷溜出去玩了~！

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
That's when we heard a scream echoing through the whole museum.
scripts.translation:
[法比奧]
就在那時，我們聽到一聲尖叫，在整個美術館裡迴盪。

scripts.text:
[Daniel]
kkakkakkaaaah!!
kkieeeeeeh!
kehkeh..
scripts.translation:
[丹尼爾]
嘎嘎嘎嘎嘎啊！！
嘎啊啊啊啊啊！
嘎嘎嘎...

scripts.text:
[Mariana]
I heard the scream too...
You boys are always making noises where you're not supposed to.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗安娜]
我也聽到了那聲尖叫...
你們這些男孩總愛在不該出聲的地方吵鬧。

scripts.text:
[Pedro]
What else are we supposed to do? If we don't do it someone else will.
scripts.translation:

[館長]
抱歉，裡面正在裝修，暫時關閉。
請使用另一邊的廁所。

scripts.text: But I forgot something inside.
scripts.translation: 但我有東西忘在裡面了

scripts.text: Give up.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Curator]
That's tooooo bad.
But my manager ordered me to stop anyone from entering this bathroom so, I should follow his orders.
scripts.translation:
[館長]
真遺憾。
但經理吩咐我不許任何人進這個廁所，我只能照辦。

scripts.text: It's such a hot day!
scripts.translation: 今天好熱啊！

scripts.text:
[Curator]
It's always hot in Brasilis but today is ridiculously hot.
Maybe I need to drink some coconut juice to cool down.
scripts.translation:
[館長]
巴西一直很熱，但今天熱得離譜。
也許我該喝點椰子汁涼快一下。

scripts.text: You give a coconut to the Curator.
scripts.translation: 你給了館長一個椰子。

scripts.text:
[Curator]
Oh really can I have it?
Thanks a lot!
scripts.translation:
[館長]
哦，真的嗎？我可以喝嗎？
太感謝了！

scripts.text:
[Curator]
Pay it forward right?
Ok I'll let you through this one time.
scripts.translation:
[館長]
這就是所謂的善有善報吧？
好吧，這次就讓你進去。

scripts.text: The curator looks around calmly then opens the door.
scripts.translation: 館長若無其事地環顧四周，然後打開了門。

scripts.text: You give up trying to enter.
scripts.translation: 你放棄了進入的嘗試。

scripts.text:
[Curator]
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[館長]
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: I need to use the bathroom.
scripts.translation: 我要去上廁所

scripts.text:
[Curator]
Sorry we are remodeling inside right now so, it's closed.
Please use the other one.
scripts.translation:
[館長]
抱歉，裡面正在裝修，暫時關閉。
請使用另一邊的廁所。

scripts.text: But I forgot something inside.
scripts.translation: 但我有東西忘在裡面了

scripts.text: Give up.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Curator]
That's tooooo bad.
But my manager ordered me to stop anyone from entering this bathroom so, I should follow his orders.
scripts.translation:
[館長]
真遺憾。
但經理吩咐我不許任何人進這個廁所，我只能照辦。

scripts.text: It's such a hot day!
scripts.translation: 今天好熱啊！

scripts.text:
[Curator]
It's always hot in Brasilis but today is ridiculously hot.
Maybe I need to drink some coconut juice to cool down.
scripts.translation:
[館長]
巴西一直很熱，但今天熱得離譜。
也許我該喝點椰子汁涼快一下。

scripts.text: You give up trying to enter.
scripts.translation: 你放棄了進入的嘗試。

scripts.text:
[Curator]
Hey thanks for the Coconut earlier it really helped me cool down.
scripts.translation:
[館長]
謝謝你之前給我的椰子，真的幫我降了降溫。

scripts.text:
[Curator]
Is it just me? Or is it hotter than it's ever been today!
scripts.translation:
[館長]
是我感覺錯了，還是今天比以往任何時候都熱？

scripts.text: The entrance has been blocked.
scripts.translation: 入口被堵住了。

scripts.text:
[Ghost]
I am a ghost who died while wandering the jungle many years ago.
scripts.translation:
[幽靈]
我是多年前在叢林中迷路而死的幽靈。

scripts.text:
[Ghost]
I found a pipeline in the jungle and followed the voice of a man to this very spot.
scripts.translation:
[幽靈]
我在叢林裡發現了一根管道，循著一個人的聲音來到了這裡。

scripts.text:
[Ghost]
That's also where I hurt one of my eyes while walking around in the dark.
scripts.translation:
[幽靈]
就在那裡，我在黑暗中摸索時弄傷了一隻眼睛。

scripts.text:
[Ghost]
I wandered these sewers for days until I found the end of this line connected to the toilet in the museum. I shouted forever begging for help but no one answered my calls.
scripts.translation:
[幽靈]
我在下水道里徘徊了好幾天，終於找到這條管道的盡頭，它連線著博物館的廁所。我一直大聲呼救，卻始終無人回應。

scripts.text:
[Ghost]
You finally answered my call but it's already way too late. Thank you for at least checking. No one else has bothered to this day.
scripts.translation:
[幽靈]
你終於回應了我的呼喚，可惜已經太遲了。至少謝謝你來看我。這麼多年來，再沒有別人理會過。

scripts.text:
[Ghost]
There are many dangerous creatures at the end of this sewer.
You seem brave though. I bet you wouldn't worry about the monsters there anyways.
scripts.translation:
[幽靈]
這條下水道的盡頭有很多危險的生物。
不過你看起來很勇敢，我想你大概不會擔心那裡的魔物吧。

scripts.text:
[Ghost]
I guess now I can finally rest in peace.
Thank you friend.
scripts.translation:
[幽靈]
我想我終於可以安息了。
謝謝你，朋友。

scripts.text: You see a rusty pipe. It seems to be linked to somewhere beneath the jungle.
scripts.translation:
你看到一根生鏽的管道。
它似乎連線著叢林下方的某個地方。

scripts.text: Examine it
scripts.translation: 檢查它

scripts.text: Ignore.
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text: You swim through a gap in the pipe and are swept by a sudden rush of water.
scripts.translation: 你遊過管道上的縫隙，被突然湧來的水流沖走了。

scripts.text: It might be dangerous, I better not act rashly.
scripts.translation: 這可能有危險，我最好別魯莽行事。

scripts.text: You see a rusty pipe. It seems to be linked to somewhere beneath the jungle.
scripts.translation:
你看到一根生鏽的管道。
它似乎連線著叢林下方的某個地方。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
I'm still preparing.
I don't require your help at this time.
Please come back later...
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
我還在準備中。
現在不需要你的幫助。
請稍後再來...

scripts.text:
[Anori]
To block Iara 
seducing the tribes
we need a purifying potion...
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
為了阻止亞拉誘惑部落族人，我們需要製作淨化藥水...

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Did you bring the materials
to make the purifying potion?
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
你帶來製作淨化藥水的材料了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Um... it seems to be okay.
I'll make you a potion which will
weaken Iara's power.
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
嗯...看起來沒問題。
我會為你製作一瓶能削弱亞拉力量的藥水。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Let's see grind this...
and mix in that...
then add some magic...
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
讓我看看...研磨這個...
再混合那個...
然後加入一些魔力...

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Here, it's completed.
Take this.
It will make Iara stop
training at the cave
for a while.
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
好了，藥水做好了。
拿著。
它能暫時阻止亞拉在洞穴裡修煉。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Please block the Iara threatening the security of the tribe.
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
請阻止威脅部落安全的亞拉。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
You haven't brought enough materials yet.
We cannot make the purification potion with only these.
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
你帶來的材料還不夠。
光靠這些我們無法制作淨化藥水。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Ah... we need a strong adventurer.
The tribe is facing a major threat.
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
啊...我們需要一位強大的冒險者。
部落正面臨巨大的威脅。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
you are...
the adventurer who came for the
purification potion...
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
你是...
那位來取淨化藥水的冒險者...

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Maybe because of the purification potion...
After that, the Iara stopped seducing tribesmen but the effect didn't last long.
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
也許是淨化藥水起了作用...
之後亞拉停止了誘惑部落族人，但效果沒持續多久。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Could you get the same
materials as before...
I need your power.
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
你能再弄到和之前一樣的材料嗎...
我需要你的力量。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Okay, I'll do it.
scripts.translation: 好的，我會去做的

scripts.text:
[Anori]
This, ah...
There is no other way.
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
這個，啊...
沒有其他辦法了。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
You are truly brave!
I, on behalf of the tribe,
offer you my thanks.
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
你真是勇敢！
我代表部落，向你表示感謝。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Materials are the same as before.
If you just get^ff0000 20 Hearts of Mermaids,
10 Leopard Claws and
3 Ancient Lips^000000,
I will make you a potion that purifies evil spirits
by using a secret formula handed down to the tribe.
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
材料和之前一樣。
只要帶來^ff0000 20個人魚之心、
10個花豹指甲和
3個古代人魚之嘴^000000，
我就會用部落秘傳的配方，為你製作淨化惡靈的藥水。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
The destiny of the tribe is up to you.
please get the materials quickly.
I will be preparing to make
the purification potion right here.
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
部落的命運就掌握在你手中。
請儘快收集材料。
我會在這裡準備製作淨化藥水。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
There are some people I haven't seen before around here.
It's a good sign...
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
最近這裡出現了一些我沒見過的人。
這是個好兆頭...

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Hey you...
Could you listen to my stories for a moment.
There's an emergency in our tribe.
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
嘿，你...
能聽我講一會兒故事嗎？
我們的部落出了急事。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text:
[Anori]
You are a heartless person...
You don't seem the helpful type.
Just keep on going your way.
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
你真是無情...
你看起來不像個樂於助人的人。
那就繼續趕路吧。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Thank you, I met a kind person.
It's a secret of our tribe that
you cannot tell anyone.
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
謝謝，你真是個好心人。
這是我們部落的秘密，千萬不能告訴別人。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Lately young men from
the tribe are disappearing.
Our entire tribe is being threatened.
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
最近部落的年輕男性接連失蹤。
整個部落都受到了威脅。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
It is likely because of a witch called Iara.
She is a water nymph seducing the hearts of young tribesmen at a cave behind the waterfall.
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
這很可能是名叫亞拉的女巫所為。
她是水之妖精，在瀑布後方的洞穴裡誘惑部落的年輕人。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
How can I stop these young tribesmen?
But I discovered a way to make a purification potion to reverse the effects of the Iara's spells.
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
我該怎麼阻止這些年輕人呢？
不過，我已經找到製作淨化藥水的方法，可以消除亞拉法術的影響。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
This potion has been handed down from many generations in our tribe.
This purification potion possesses the power to cleanse evil spirits.
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
這藥水是我們部落世代相傳的。
它擁有淨化惡靈的力量。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
If you could get the materials
I will make you
the purification potion.
Could you do that for me?
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
如果你能收集到材料，我就能為你製作淨化藥水。
你能幫我嗎？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes, I can.
scripts.translation: 是的，我可以

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Hm...
Well, then.
If you change your mind you can come to me again.
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
嗯...
好吧。
如果你改變主意了，可以再回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
You shouldn't talk about
what you heard now to anyone
It's kind of embarrassing...
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
剛才聽到的事千萬別告訴別人。
說出來怪難為情的...

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Oh! You are the savior
of our tribe indeed.
On behalf of the tribe, I offer you my thanks.
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
哦！你真是我們部落的救星。
我代表部落，向你表示感謝。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Well, what we need is this.
It's all you can get from near here.
Note down well.
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
嗯，我們需要這些材料。
這些都是附近能找到的。
請仔細記下來。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
^ff0000 20 Hearts of Mermaids
10 Leopard Claws
3 Ancient Lips^000000
are the only ones that are needed as the materials.
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
^ff0000 20個人魚之心
10個花豹指甲
3個古代人魚之嘴^000000
只需要這些材料。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
When you get those, I will make you a potion that purifies evil spirits using a secret formula handed down to the tribe.
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
拿到這些材料後，我會用部落傳承的秘密配方，為你製作一瓶能淨化惡靈的藥水。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
The destiny of the tribe is up to you.
I hope you move quickly.
Even at this moment, the village men are being seduced and slipping way...
scripts.translation:
[阿諾里]
部落的命運就掌握在你手中。
請儘快行動。
此時此刻，村裡的男人們仍在受誘惑，陸續離開...

[Iara]
Ah...this light is...
It's like getting cleansed of evil thoughts
from deep within my heart.
scripts.translation:
[亞拉]
啊...這道光...
彷彿我內心深處的邪念都被淨化了。

scripts.text:
[Iara]
At last I can forget the curse that I placed on myself when I drowned in the water.
scripts.translation:
[亞拉]
終於，我可以忘掉自己溺水時施加在身上的詛咒了。

scripts.text:
[Iara]
Do you think I can be born again as a kind water nymph?
scripts.translation:
[亞拉]
你覺得我能重新轉世為善良的水仙女嗎？

scripts.text:
[Iara]
Ah... Thank you for helping me recover my consciousness for a while.

scripts.translation:

啊...謝謝你讓我暫時恢復了意識。

scripts.text:

[亞拉]
啊哈~...

scripts.translation:
[亞拉]
詛咒的力量太強了，我快要控制不住了。

[Native Warrior]
When will she come out of the waterfall again...?
